paper_insights.title: Demography, Stature & Physiological Childhood Stress
paper_insights.summary: Bioarchaeological assessment of female skeletons reveals a mean stature of 158.4 cm reflecting distinct sexual dimorphism. Linear enamel hypoplasias (LEH) on permanent dentition indicate recurrent physiological stress episodes during early childhood (ages 2–4), with stabilization in adolescence.

paper_insights.title: Costume Jewelry & Crafts as Markers of Social Status
paper_insights.summary: The association of gilded bronze and silver earrings (with polyhedral and grape pendants) with multi-strand imported glass bead necklaces demonstrates pronounced hierarchical differentiation. Spindle whorls in nearly one-third of female graves emphasize the socio-economic status of textile production.

paper_insights.title: Horizontal Stratigraphy & Spatial Trajectories
paper_insights.summary: Hexagonal spatial binning (3-meter cell size) captures horizontal cemetery stratigraphy from the Early Avar period through the Middle Avar peak into the Late Avar period. Burial concentrations follow distinct linear ribbons, pointing to kin-group plots without disclosing individual coordinate points.

hexbin_maps.title: Chronology in 3-Meter Hexagons (Total Cemetery)
hexbin_maps.description: Spatial distribution of chronological phases across the entire cemetery using 3-meter hexagonal tessellation. Each cell represents the dominant dated phase among documented burials.
hexbin_maps.methodology: 3m inter-edge hexagon distance · Dominant chronological phase per bin · Undated burials neutral

hexbin_maps.title: Chronology in 3-Meter Hexagons by Sex
hexbin_maps.description: Comparative hexagonal binning of male and female spatial trajectories, illuminating gendered cemetery growth and shared burial plots over time.
hexbin_maps.methodology: Dual-panel comparative hexbin matrix · Subadults omitted from sex panels · 3m cell width

hexbin_maps.title: Female Lifeworlds: Social Status and Chronology
hexbin_maps.description: Comprehensive cartographic synthesis of 166 adult female burials, cross-referencing grave good status categories with chronological horizon and spatial clusters.
hexbin_maps.methodology: Multi-tier status classification · Chronological horizon overlay · n = 166 adult females

hexbin_maps.title: Social Status by Sex Across the Adult Population
hexbin_maps.description: Comparative distribution of social status indicators across 348 adult individuals (166 females, 182 males) across the Csokorgasse burial ground.
hexbin_maps.methodology: Costume elements, weaponry, and prestige goods · Disturbed/robbed graves indicated · n = 348

hexbin_maps.title: Cemetery Extent & Convex Hulls
hexbin_maps.description: Descriptive spatial enclosures and boundary sectors of the cemetery phases. Hulls serve as analytical cluster boundaries.
hexbin_maps.methodology: Descriptive convex hulls per phase · Spatial core density zones · Excludes excavation trench limits
